sentences.text: Lab Report: Training dynamics of deep models
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 12 GB of memory.
Each experiment was repeated 5 times with different random seeds.
Figure 1 shows the f1 score during training.
As shown in Figure 1, from epoch 20 to epoch 24, the F1 score of Transformer improves by a relative 2.7%.
CNN reaches 67.3% F1 score at epoch 12.
As shown in Figure 1, at epoch 2, CNN is 14.7 points better than Transformer.
Figure 2 shows the test accuracy by dataset.
LSTM achieves 86.2% test accuracy on AG News (Figure 2).
As shown in Figure 2, LSTM achieves over 85% test accuracy on AG News.
On SST-2, DistilBERT is 55.5 points better than VGG-16.
DistilBERT outperforms LSTM by 2.4 percentage points on MNIST (Figure 2).
On CIFAR-10, SVM obtains an accuracy of 70.2%.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
